content: claude.ai custom connectors (official docs, 2026-11): available on Free/Pro/Max/Ultra/Team/Enterprise; Free limited to ONE custom connector; Team/Enterprise only Owners add. Install link only prefills dialog: claude.ai/customize/connectors?modal=add-custom-connector&connectorName=..&connectorUrl=.. (user must confirm). File transfers are directory-only beta, NOT available to custom connectors. Limits: ~150,000 chars tool result, 240s tool timeout (Claude Code 25k tokens). No sampling, no resource subscriptions. OAuth: 401 + WWW-Authenticate resource_metadata required; resource must equal URL exactly; first authorization_servers entry only; CIMD needs client_id_metadata_document_supported + 'none' auth method else DCR; redirect https://claude.ai/api/mcp/auth_callback plus port-agnostic loopback for Claude Code; S256 PKCE; token endpoint form-urlencoded; 10s limit discovery/register/token, 30s refresh; invalid_grant on dead refresh; rotate refresh tokens; no cross-host redirects; IPv4 only; port 443 only; egress 160.79.104.0/21; auth settings/URL not editable after add; tools/list cached up to ~6h.
